FULL TEXT:
Advertisement
Applications are invited for the said positions under BioNEST, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
The candidate will be appointed initially for a period of 1 year or till the tenure of the project,
whichever is earlier. However, the post can be extended on the basis of evaluation after
completion of the tenure if the project is extended. The post is purely temporary and co-
terminus with the project. There shall be no financial liability on the part of the University,
after the termination of the project. The incumbent shall have no claim whatsoever for the
regularization of his/her services.
a) Name of Position: COO
Number of positions: One
Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. in any subject of life sciences or M.Sc.-MBA or M. Sc.
in any subject of life sciences with minimum 10 years of experience. Preference will be
given to candidates having relevant experience in project handling and/or entrepreneurship
development programs with
 Knowledge of Technology Transfer.
 Knowledge of GeM portal.
 Candidates having granted/ filed patents.
Desirable qualifications:
 E-tendering of instrument purchases.
 Maintaining the upkeep of the BioNEST incubator.
 An overall understanding of the process of bio-incubation.
 Enhancing the visibility of the incubator set-up.
 Handling of scientific equipment and interpretation of results.
 Facilitating scientific liaison between innovators (individuals/ start-ups), mentors &
industry.
 Hand holding the Incubatees/ Innovators.
 Helping the entrepreneurs in developing proposals for raising funds.
Emoluments: Rs. 74,000/- (fixed per month)
Kindly mention the post you are applying for in the subject of email. Applications (consist of
cover letter stating experience, role and contribution to the organizational goals) should reach
on or before 16th July 2024 by E-mail to bionestpu@pu.ac.in and the signed hard copy of the
same be sent by post to the undersigned.
 The candidates shortlisted for the interview (offline mode) will be informed through E-
mail or telephone.
 The candidates need to send a scanned copy of all the certificates including experience
letters (if any).
 No TA/ DA will be paid for attending the interview.
Prof. Rohit Sharma
Project Leader
BioNEST
Panjab University
Chandigarh
